prompt: We have a stateless Node.js/Express service running as 3 identical replicas (app1, app2, app3) behind an nginx load balancer. Most traffic is a cheap GET /status health check, but a subset of requests hit POST /compute, which does a heavy, purely synchronous computation. In production, overall tail latency spikes badly and one replica consistently turns into a "hot node" with an ever-growing request queue while the other two sit relatively idle — even though the /compute handler passes all its unit tests and looks logically correct. Below is the nginx upstream config and the Express server code exactly as deployed. Walk me through why one node piles up and latency becomes uneven, and how you'd fix it.
